topic: The painting that shows a completely different person every time you photograph it
hook: This painting shows a different face every time you photograph it.
script: This painting shows a different face every time you photograph it. The Crying Boy painting by Bruno Amadio became notorious in 1985 when The Sun reported that copies were found unburned in the ruins of house fires across Britain. The fires destroyed everything. The painting survived every time. Superstition spread. Fire stations refused to store the prints. The artist has never been conclusively identified. The faces in photos still shift.
